gen-dafont-neon-gf-abeezee: Glowing and vibrant, Neon draws each letter in one unbroken line, like lit glass tubing. ABeeZee sits beneath in a friendly sans-serif, its terminals stopping well short of the stem, and it saves the headline work for big, short words.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-aldrich: Tall, stamped, and humming with light. Neon leads with that metal-type lowercase, and Aldrich follows in a modern sans whose round letters feel cupped rather than clenched, so you can scale it up or down freely.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-alexandria: A flat gray hum of light, all one line weight. Neon holds that glow up top, while Alexandria below stretches tall with wide open terminals, giving the page a bright sign and a quieter, easier voice.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-amiko: Neon traces every letter with a steady, unshaded outline, so the heading reads like glass tubing switched on in the dark. Amiko's sans terminals flare outward below it.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-anek-bangla: Lit-up tubing, no thick or thin anywhere. Anek Bangla takes over below as a contemporary sans, with wide s curves barely curled in and a short climb to its ascenders.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-anek-devanagari: Glare-proof and vibrant, Neon never lets a stroke thin out into nothing, and its lowercase stands tall like stamped metal. But Anek Devanagari, a plain sans with open mouths and a tall middle zone, keeps the text comfortable to read.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati brings a clean, approachable sans-serif body whose lowercase nearly rivals the capitals, with a gaping c opening. Neon above it keeps one constant stroke thickness, and you might give the body a generous size to show that off.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Vibrant is the word for Neon, whose strokes look drawn with one fixed nib and spaced out generously. Anek Gurmukhi follows in a clean sans, with big open counters in every small letter and curves that swing wide.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-anek-kannada: Lines that bend like a straw into letter form make Neon instantly recognizable, glowing at every size. And Anek Kannada, a plain sans with a high x-height and terminals stopping far from the stem, gives it a solid, contemporary partner.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-anek-latin: A constant stroke from top to baseline gives Neon its glowing, stamped-metal look, with tall lowercase forms and open spacing throughout. Anek Latin keeps things steady beneath it.
